msg: The best colours to pick appear to go in runs and then flip. Sometimes the lighter hats are best, then after about 10-15 goes it flips to the darker hats being best. When the mushroom count declines below around 4 it might time to switch colour. I had a feeling that perhaps the lighter hats were more successful slightly more of the time (for longer runs) than the darker hats, but I'm not certain. It seems there might also be periods when all the woods have few mushrooms, regardless of who you pick.
